question: Was the Chinese account opened on a PASSPORT (not a PRC resident identity card)?
if_yes: The bank recorded you as an OVERSEAS INDIVIDUAL (境外个人). PBOC Order [2006] No.3 Art. 37(2) puts a foreign citizen holding a passport in that category, and Art. 28 makes the opening documents decisive.
if_no: The bank recorded you as a DOMESTIC INDIVIDUAL (境内个人). PBOC Order [2006] No.3 Art. 37(1) limits that category to Chinese citizens holding a PRC resident ID, military ID or armed-police ID.

question: Have you resided CONTINUOUSLY in mainland China for a full year?
if_yes: A second, conflicting definition is engaged: State Council Order 532 Art. 52(2) counts a foreigner continuously resident for a full year as a DOMESTIC INDIVIDUAL. The two instruments disagree. Ask the account-opening bank which category your account carries in the personal FX monitoring system; Art. 28 makes the bank's record operative.
if_no: Only the PBOC definition is engaged and you are an overseas individual.
governing_text: State Council Order 532 Art. 52(2) vs PBOC Order [2006] No. 3 Art. 37

question: Do you hold a 外国人永久居留身份证 (Foreign Permanent Residence Identity Card)?
if_yes: Guidelines Art. 59 para 2: the annual convenience amount for FX PURCHASE applies to you. You can purchase up to USD 50,000 equivalent per year on identity document alone.
if_no: Guidelines Art. 59 para 2 does NOT extend the purchase convenience amount to you. Your purchase leg runs on documents, not on a quota.
governing_text: 汇发〔2020〕14号 Guidelines Art. 59 para 2; SAFE Tianjin 2024 Q&A (九)

question: Is the money LAWFUL CURRENT-ACCOUNT RMB INCOME earned onshore (salary, labour remuneration, rent, royalties, service fees, business income)?
if_yes: This is the main documented route. Guidelines Art. 59 and PBOC Art. 13 allow the purchase AND the remittance on identity document plus amount-bearing source-of-funds documents INCLUDING A TAX CERTIFICATE. SAFE Ningxia confirms there is no amount limit on genuine, lawful current-account purchase and settlement.
if_no: The current-account route is not available to you. Continue to C5-C8; the money's legal character must be established before any route applies.
governing_text: 汇发〔2020〕14号 Guidelines Art. 59; PBOC Order [2006] No. 3 Art. 13; SAFE Ningxia 2022释疑(八)

question: Is the balance ALREADY in USD or another foreign currency, sitting in an FX account?
if_yes: NO PURCHASE IS NEEDED, so there is no spread to pay at all. Guidelines Art. 65(1): an overseas individual remits FX from an FX account on identity document alone, with no amount threshold stated. Art. 64(1) for a domestic individual: up to USD 50,000 equivalent per day on identity document, above that identity document plus amount-bearing materials.
if_no: You must purchase the FX first, and the purchase leg is what carries the documentation burden and the spread.

question: Is the money the proceeds of selling ONSHORE REAL PROPERTY that you own?
if_yes: Capital account. PBOC Art. 22: RMB proceeds of an overseas individual's sale of onshore commercial residential property may, SUBJECT TO SAFE APPROVAL, be purchased into FX and remitted out. IIT is charged at 20% on the GAIN (proceeds less original value and reasonable expenses), and the IIT payment certificate is inspected before the transfer can be registered.
governing_text: PBOC Order [2006] No. 3 Art. 22; IIT Law Arts. 3(3), 6(5), 15 para 2

question: Are you EMIGRATING and cancelling your Chinese household registration (户口)?
if_yes: SEQUENCE IS MANDATORY AND BACKWARDS FROM WHAT MOST PEOPLE ASSUME: IIT Law Art. 13 para 4 requires the tax clearance to be completed BEFORE the household registration is cancelled, and Art. 10(5) makes the cancellation a filing trigger. Only then can 汇发〔2014〕2号 §6 be used: approval at the SAFE branch of your ORIGINAL hukou location, and since 2014 a single lump-sum remittance is permitted and the RMB 500,000 head-office filing and the notarisation requirements are abolished.
if_no: The emigrant property-transfer route is not available. A US citizen who never held a Chinese hukou cannot use it at all.

question: Is the money your share of a LAWFULLY LIQUIDATED foreign-invested enterprise?
if_yes: State Council Order 532 Art. 22 para 3: after liquidation and tax payment in accordance with relevant State provisions, the RMB belonging to the foreign investor may be purchased into FX and remitted out through an institution operating FX settlement and sale business.

question: Can you produce a GENUINE, LAWFUL transaction background for the money at all?
if_yes: Order 532 Art. 5 provides that the State does not restrict current-account international payments and transfers; Guidelines Art. 54 requires a genuine and lawful transaction background for personal current-account FX business; Art. 68 lets the bank refuse anything whose authenticity is doubtful. With documents, a route exists.
if_no: NO LAWFUL PERSONAL ROUTE WAS IDENTIFIED IN THE INSTRUMENTS REVIEWED. Do not fall back on an informal channel: Order 532 Art. 45 reaches private and disguised FX dealing with a fine of up to 30% of the amount (30%-100% where serious), Art. 39 reaches unlawful outward transfer on the same scale, and the U.S. side adds a structuring penalty of up to the full amount involved.
governing_text: State Council Order 532 Arts. 5, 39, 45; Guidelines Arts. 54, 68; 31 U.S.C. §5321(a)(4)
